  Your new company  
 An exciting opportunity exists for an experienced Customer Service Officer to join a fast-paced and customer-focused organisation based in Camberwell. This role is ideal for candidates who thrive in a high-volume environment and are passionate about delivering exceptional customer service to the community.   
 Please note: Due to the urgent nature of this requirement, applications should be submitted by Sunday to be considered for interviews scheduled early next week. 
   
  Your new role  
 As a Customer Service Officer, you will be the first point of contact for customer enquiries across multiple channels, including phone, email and face-to-face interactions. Your responsibilities will include: 
 
 Managing high volumes of customer enquiries 
 Providing accurate information and resolving customer issues 
 Handling complaints with professionalism and empathy 
 Processing customer requests and maintaining accurate records 
 Working within CRM systems, with Oracle or Salesforce experience is highly regarded. 
 Delivering excellent customer service while meeting service standards and KPIs 
 
  What you'll need to succeed  
 To be successful in this role, you will have: 
 
 Experience within a contact centre or high-volume customer service environment 
 Strong communication and problem-solving skills 
 Experience handling customer enquiries and complaint resolution 
 Proficiency using CRM systems (Oracle or Salesforce highly regarded) 
 Excellent attention to detail and administration skills 
 Experience within local or state government is preferred. However, candidates from retail, hospitality, banking, utilities or similar customer-focused environments are encouraged to apply. 
 
  What you'll get in return  
 
 Attractive hourly rate of $40-$45 per hour + super 
 Full-time hours 
 Supportive team environment 
 Opportunity to gain valuable public sector experience 
 Immediate start available 
 
  What you need to do now

result.description:
Taxi Driver

•	Permanent Role 
•	$70k-$80k PA 
•	Cairns QLD

POSITION

We have full-time positions available for Taxi Drivers in Cairns 4870. 

SKILLS

The role requires you to have;
•	at least a relevant Certificate II or Certificate III or at least 12 months of relevant work experience OR
•	2 Years of relevant work experience AND
•	Current QLD driver authorization

RESPONSIBILITIES

As a Taxi Driver you will be responsible for the safe and efficient transport of passengers on a fee-for-service basis using a metered fare system. This role requires strong driving and navigation skills to ensure timely and accurate journeys and a high standard of customer service to create a positive experience for all passengers. You will be expected to demonstrate professionalism, courtesy and reliability while assisting with passenger needs, managing fare transactions, and maintaining knowledge of local routes, traffic conditions and destinations.

POSITION DUTIES
•	You will be required to undertake the following duties;
•	Operate a taxi to safely pick up passengers from designated locations, taxi ranks, or in response to hails and booking requests.
•	Confirm passenger destinations and determine the most efficient and safe travel routes, taking into account traffic and road conditions.
•	Use mobile computer systems and radio communication networks to receive, manage, and respond to passenger bookings in a timely manner.
•	Provide reliable, courteous, and professional transport services to ensure passengers enjoy a comfortable and positive travel experience.
•	Assist passengers with luggage, mobility aids, or other needs to support safe boarding and departure.
•	Accurately calculate and collect fares, process cash or electronic payments, and issue receipts as required.
•	Maintains accurate records of completed trips, including mileage and fares collected.
•	Maintains cleanliness of taxi and ensure any vehicle maintenance is completed.  

SALARY

The position will attract a salary between $70 000 to $80 000 per annum. 

TO APPLY
Applications in Word format should be submitted via our website: 
https://precruitment.com.au/job-seekers/

faults.  •    Repairing or replacing worn, damaged or defective mechanical and electrical components using appropriate tools and manufacturer-approved repair procedures.  •    Reassembling engines and The company provides reliable, high-quality automotive services to both private and commercial clients, with a strong focus on professionalism, safety, and customer satisfaction. As the business continues to grow, ACETUNE MOBILE MECHANIC PTY. LTD. remains committed to delivering efficient and dependable automotive solutions while maintaining Australian industry standards. result.description: The Trustee for the Swartz Family Trust  The position is responsible for fabricating, repairing and welding metal components for heavy earthmoving, agricultural and industrial equipment. The role involves interpreting engineering drawings, manufacturing and assembling metal parts, and delivering precision repairs to support RiteBore's onsite lineboring and heavy machinery services.   Key Responsibilities    Fabricate, assemble and repair metal components and structures used in heavy machinery and industrial equipment.   Operate and maintain ELSA Supercombinata lineboring equipment, facing head and computerised ELSA bore welding system.  Interpret engineering drawings, blueprints and specifications to determine fabrication requirements.   Mark out, cut, shape and form structural steel and metal components using hand tools, power tools and fabrication equipment.   Perform welding using MIG & Bore welder welding techniques to manufacture and repair heavy equipment components.   Carry out line boring preparation, hard facing, gouging and associated fabrication works.  Fit fabricated metal components and ensure correct alignment and tolerances.   Inspect completed fabrication work to ensure compliance with engineering specifications and quality standards.   Perform maintenance and repairs on buckets, booms, pins, bushes, agricultural machinery and earthmoving equipment.   Operate fabrication machinery including presses, grinders, drills, cutting equipment and other workshop machinery safely and efficiently.   Maintain a safe, clean and organised work environment while complying with workplace health and safety procedures.    What We’re Looking For    At least 3 Years of experience operating lineboring equipment.  Supplier approved training Certificate for ELSA lineboring equipment (Highly recommended).  Knowledge and experience on Elsa line boring machines (Highly Recommended).   Australian Recognised Fitter/Welder Trade Certificate (Fitter & welder).  Experience in overlay welding.  Machining of Faces and Flanges.  Demonstrated experience in lineboring welding machine maintenance, repairing components for machinery such as CAT, Liebherr, Sandvik equipment, Hitachi, Komatsu(Velmet), John Deere and Tiger cat.  Display a clear commitment and focus on the health, safety, and well-being of all employees.  Strong interpersonal and communication skills.  Hold a valid Australian Drivers Licence.  Willingness to undertake a Pre-Employment Medical & Drug/Alcohol Screen.      About Company    RiteBore is a small, family-owned, onsite lineboring and welding business based in Bunbury, Western Australia. We  provide onsite Lineboring & Welding, Maintenance, Fitting & Field Service on Agricultural & Earthmoving Equipment  throughout Western Australia, supporting the mining and earthmoving industry. result.description:
Ron Finemore Transport is looking for experienced full-time Heavy Vehicle Truck drivers in the Albury / Wodonga, Wagga, Orange & Goulburn areas.

Your key responsibilities: 
•	Safely & legally transport goods & products using company specified & supplied heavy vehicle to designated customer sites 
•	Predominantly interstate & long-distance driving
•	Responsible for management and condition of heavy vehicle, its state of roadworthiness, along with security & integrity of the loaded goods while driving safely & legally based on road and traffic conditions
•	Assess the condition of the vehicle before, during & after all trips
•	Assess the nature of the loaded goods & ensure they are positioned and restrained correctly as per the National Load Restraint guidelines & that any temperature control requirements are within the required range.
•	Assess the mass of the vehicle & goods are safe, legal & compliant
•	Assess the assigned trip can be completed safely allowing for suitable rest breaks & not exceeding the relevant speed limits
•	Maintain a suitable level of fitness and wellbeing to ensure fitness for duty before & during any trip
•	Communicate with and assist RFT staff, customers & regulators both during normal interactions & when any disruption or emergency occurs
•	Interact & engage with a range of in-cab and trailer technology to meet contractual requirements and ensure safe, legal & compliant driving & control of product.
•	Strong understanding and commitment to safety
•	Liaising with customers with a friendly and professional attitude
•	Completion of all paperwork on time and in full
•	Driving in a time-sensitive environment
•	Refuelling and maintaining cleanliness of allocated equipment
•	Promptly report any mechanical faults, delivery issues or delays
•	Reading and following procedures and relevant work instructions
•	Submitting log-book pages to compliance team time-to-time

Benefits
•	Operating state-of-the-art, modern fleet equipment
•	Above award wages - minimum annual salary $79,700 excl superannuation & additional incentive payments
•	Extra incentive payments in accordance with Enterprise Agreement for:
o	length of service
o	safe & incident free performance
o	additional and weekend trips
o	Excellent conditions
o	Uniform provided
o	Health and well-being programs
o	Social club
 

Skills and Experience required: 
•	Suitable experience in operating & driving a heavy vehicle including commercial driving & skills in manoeuvring vehicle at varying speeds in difficult situations
•	Experience with in-cab equipment technology such as computer tablets, setting & monitoring temperature control equipment & electronic communication
•	Heavy Vehicle HC or MC licence
•	Minimum of 12 months good driving record
•	Must have ability to read, write & perform simple mathematical ability to handle receipts, read maps, road signs, maintain logs, complete load documentation, etc.
•	Suitable knowledge to activate & engage vehicle systems including adaptive cruise control, engine braking systems & Guardian safety system
•	Must be able to sit & remain alert while driving
•	Must be able to enter & exit the vehicles cab up to 10 times per day, perform occasional squatting & crouching to handle & position freight
•	All positions will have some weekend work
•	All applicants must be able to work to a roster
•	Ability to work within an established Environment, Health and Safety (EHS) system

About Ron Finemore Transport:
Ron Finemore Transport (RFT) is a nationally recognised, regional transport and logistics business servicing the Eastern States of Australia. Established in 2004 to meet the road freight needs of regional industries and communities. RFT has grown into a leading company of over 900 people with more than 600 trailers, vans and prime movers.  A strong, values-based company, RFT people are dedicated to providing safe, cost-effective and reliable delivery of food and fuel products into our local communities.

To Apply:
Successful applicants will be required to undergo a pre-employment medical and national crime check.  

All applicants need to supply their resume or a document stating their driving experience, qualifications, and contact details. If able, please provide copies of your relevant licences for the position and if applicable, applicant must supply evidence of current visa. 

Please forward your resume to apply@rft.net.au
